items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 48:1
items.html: Because what is received from the Peh [mouth] is the light of Nefesh, and what is received from the Hotem [nose] is the light of Ruach, and so forth. Indeed, in the vessels it is the opposite, for the level of Keter is from the Peh, and the level of Hochma from the Hotem, and so forth. And this is the inverse relation between vessels and lights.
